summary: Already for the exact target form Q=2XY+Z^2 with independent cap-one densities, the radial coarea slices J_rho(q) admit no law-independent integrable pointwise majorant uniform in q. For every R>=2 an explicit product law and q=-R^2 give J_rho(q)>=1/(2R) throughout rho in [R,R+1/(8R)]. A countable rational-cover argument forces any universal envelope w to satisfy w(rho)>=1/(2rho) a.e. The full conjecture is not refuted: account02/B05 QFORM-THREE-BANK-GENERAL-CORE-v1 gives ||p_(2XY+Z^2)||_infinity<36 for the same laws. The corrected debt is a joint stationary-ridge radial trace estimate that integrates rho before any pointwise radial supremum.
